fullContent:
Grahani Kapata Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurved Sarsangrah, edition 17, page no – 282 
 Grahani Kapata Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the tablet form. This medicine is given to treat the all digestive problems like diarrhea, abdomen pain, and blood in stools etc. It balances the tridoshas – vata, pitta and kapha in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shudh para (Purified Mercury) – 24 gm 
 Shudh gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 120 gm 
 Shudh afeem – 48 gm 
 Kaudi bhasma – 84 gm 
 Shudh bachnag – 12 gm 
 Kali marich (black pepper) – 96 gm 
 Shudh dhatoora seeds – 240 gm 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly kajjali of para – gandhak is prepared and then rest of ingredients are mixed to make the tablets of 125 mg. 
 Dosage 
 Take 1-2 tablets with one gram powder of cumin mixed in honey. 
 Indications 
 
 Diarrhea 
 Abdomen pain 
 Blood in loose motion 
 Burning sensation during defecation 
 
 Side Effects 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
